In the news this week, we talk Bambu Lab and its legal threat sent to a third-party developer of open source software, plus GN's plans to deep-dive into Bambu Lab's shady behaviors. We also go over the plunge in consumer hardware and computer hardware sales (with a trailer for our upcoming special report), AMD's negative projects for the gaming industry as it gets into bed with data centers, Switch 2 price hikes, and residents paying billions for data center power buildouts. Additionally, the FCC router ban has some changes to the firmware update schedule, but none to the core ban itself.
